case_number: 2025 INSC 435; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO…………..OF 2025 [@ SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRL) NO.13369 OF 2024]
summary: Murder conviction under IPC s.302/34 upheld; premeditation established by accused approaching victims' home armed with deadly weapons; ocular testimony of injured grandchildren corroborated; motive of enmity over disputed land worship; medical evidence of blunt force head injury consistent with axe blow; possibility of death by fall rejected; High Court confirmation of life sentence affirmed.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; conviction and sentence confirmed.
